---
title: "1 · The Second Quantum Revolution"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

The second quantum revolution: generating, storing, manipulating and detecting many-body entanglement, and machine learning for quantum technologies, from the variational quantum eigensolver and the optimisation of quantum circuits to quantum state tomography, error correction and error mitigation with neural networks. The lecture closes with the literature on machine learning for physics and for science.
